steps.note: Sign into the existing pantry-gate Supabase project in the visible browser. Use normal account login; no credentials go into this plan.
In Authentication > URL Configuration, verify the Site URL matches the existing HUMKIN consent location. Don't change it casually because existing apps depend on it.
In Authentication > OAuth Server, enable OAuth 2.1 and use authorization path /oauth/consent/. Leave dynamic client registration disabled for this owner-only pilot.
Register a confidential OAuth client named Static Fileport with redirect https://fileport.abundent.org/api/static-id/callback and PKCE S256. Save client ID and secret privately.
Sign in if necessary. Open Workers & Pages > fileport > Settings > Variables and Secrets > Production. Preserve the existing FILEPORT_ADMIN_TOKEN recovery secret.

Add encrypted STATIC_ID_CLIENT_ID and STATIC_ID_CLIENT_SECRET from the registered OAuth app. Add STATIC_ID_OWNER_SUB from the existing verified Supabase Auth user UUID. Add a distinct STATIC_ID_COOKIE_KEY generated securely, not the admin token.
Redeploy Fileport. Check the sign-in on fileport.abundent.org; approve the Fileport OAuth consent only if the requesting application and redirect are exactly right.
Test owner access, an expired session, and emergency admin recovery. Do not delete any established login until verified.
